basic_info.description: Trophy building in prime Pacific Heights location. House-like, 5 BR, two-level owner's unit with views and private elevator. Ideally located within blocks of the amenities of Union, Fillmore and Polk Streets. Walk Score 98! 2606 Octavia is a 2BR/2BA with private garage. 2608 Octavia is a 1BR/1BA with private garage and both are tenant occupied. The 5BR/4BA owner's unit (1890 Vallejo) includes a pent room opening to a roof deck, large private garage, and an elevator from the garage to both levels. Tons of period charm, very light and bright. Interesting opportunity for an owner occupier to have income or an investor to own a prime corner of Pacific Heights real estate.
